description: Author-curated routing smoke set for the 18 UG1399 v2026.1 fix cards. It tests retrieval identity, not repair correctness or Vitis validation.

queries.query: Vitis kernel m_axi offset pragma direct slave off; which offset setting should I keep for XRT integration?
titles: m_axi offset: let the Vitis kernel flow select the offset

queries.query: Vivado IP m_axi base address needs fixed zero, external runtime port, or host control: offset off direct slave
titles: m_axi offset: choose off, direct, or slave for Vivado IP

queries.query: ap_uint operator[] bit selection valid index LSB highest bit
titles: ap_uint bit selection: use a valid zero-based bit index

queries.query: ap_uint range(Hi,Lo) returns proxy and Hi less than Lo reverses bits
titles: ap_uint range selection: use Hi/Lo order and materialize the proxy

queries.query: synthesis fails around sleep time getc file IO system calls in the HLS function
titles: Unsupported C/C++ system calls in synthesizable code

queries.query: malloc free dynamic memory allocation is not synthesizable; replace with fixed bounded storage
titles: Replace dynamic memory allocation in synthesized code

queries.query: recursive function and tail recursion cannot be synthesized
titles: Remove recursion from a synthesizable function

queries.query: STL container uses dynamic allocation or recursion in synthesizable C++
titles: Avoid unsupported dynamic/recursive C++ standard template libraries

queries.query: DATA_PACK pragma unsupported; migrate to AGGREGATE packed attribute
titles: Replace deprecated or unsupported DATA_PACK pragma

queries.query: INTERFACE mode ap_bus is unsupported in Vitis HLS; use m_axi
ap_uint undeclared or ap_int not found; which header and include path are required?
titles: Include ap_int.h for ap_int and ap_uint types

queries.query: hls_math.h included from C instead of C++; hls namespace float double conversion
titles: Use hls_math.h only from C++ and match the math type

queries.query: blocking hls::stream read write deadlocks because FIFO depth is too small
titles: Use blocking hls::stream APIs for deterministic FIFO behavior

queries.query: write_nb non-blocking AXI4-Stream axis is unsupported and C simulation cannot prove FIFO full behavior
titles: Treat non-blocking hls::stream behavior as an RTL-only risk

queries.query: DATAFLOW fanout violates single producer single consumer; split task is needed
DATAFLOW loop contains break and continue with multiple exit conditions
titles: Remove break/continue multiple exits from a dataflow region

queries.query: WARNING SCHED 204-68 unable to enforce carried dependency target II 1 final II 4 RAW
titles: Handle carried dependencies before forcing PIPELINE II=1

queries.query: WARNING SCHED 204-69 limited memory ports array load target II 1 final II 2 ARRAY_PARTITION
titles: Use ARRAY_PARTITION for array memory-port contention
